source.title: Aspirin and risk of multiple myeloma in adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis.

scope: All six pages of supplied systematic review/meta-analysis of aspirin and MM risk in adults. Verify search cutoff/eligibility/study design/family and exposures, incident MM versus treatment/survival purpose, pooled/subgroup estimates and uncertainty/heterogeneity, confounding and dose/duration distinctions, publication bias/sensitivity limitations and harm/nulls. Secondary associations do not prove prevention causality, aspirin anticancer efficacy after diagnosis or clinical recommendations.
